evaluator_inputs: claims_dev.jsonl loaded only by the separate scoring command after predictions exist

selection.tokenization: lowercase alphanumeric tokens; fixed stopword list; no stemming

denominator.unit: all 300 dev claims in the pinned release

limitations: Development split only; no hidden or official test score.
This component evaluates scientific-claim evidence semantics and is not patent-device gold or clinical truth.
The lexical predictor is a baseline control, not a proposed adaptive method.
